t: Durable, rechargeable LED work light with built in USB power bank for charging devices on the go. 2 lighting modes, delivering 1000lm and 500lm of adjustable cool white light, to illuminate any work area. Long life battery, 2hr 30min on max light output and 5hr on min light output. Features magnetic base, foldable design and clamp function for multiple stand positions. Supplied with USB-C charging cable.
